releaseBoundary: Packages and a local-model verification contract are supplied; model weights, model directories, provider accounts, source media and project outputs are never bundled.

requiredFiles: one of model.safetensors, model.safetensors.index.json, pytorch_model.bin or pytorch_model.bin.index.json
localModelContract.verification: The runner records a SHA-256 manifest and a stable fingerprint of every local model file before and after conversion; a changed model directory fails the run.
operatorResponsibilities: Obtain and retain the model licence and commercial-use evidence outside this repository.
Keep the model directory local and out of Git.
Record the produced model fingerprint with the project execution evidence.

compatibilityNote: These are observed reference versions, not a cross-platform binary lock. Re-run the optional route's local preflight after changing Python, hardware or package versions.
